Fig. 1. Overall architecture of the proposed ELC method. In the training stage, dual-stream encoders (including trainable encoders and frozen mentor encoders) extract features from image-text pairs. Evidential representations are constructed and modeled as Dirichlet distributions to represent uncertainty, and the network is jointly optimized through EDL, UCL, and RL. In the test stage, a query sample is evaluated based on its predictive uncertainty. Queries with low uncertainty are directly trusted for retrieval, whereas high-uncertainty samples are further refined through RS-TTA to improve retrieval reliability.
